title: part 2 of how i calmed down my period

segments.text: It's day 43 of me tracking my female hormones and something wild happened. Keep in mind, this is among the most stressed I've ever been. We're incorporating this new protocol, I'm doing all these things, I have all these eyes on me, and yet it was my calmest cycle ever. Well, we have a few theories why this might be the case. One, consistency. Your cycle is run by your hypothalamus. It's the part of your brain that regulates your sleep and your stress. And we know that unstable schedules disrupt your cycle. A meta-analysis of 14 studies found that women with irregular schedules had a 35%

higher odds of having irregular cycles versus women that didn't. [music] And for women under 30, it's 66% higher. But my protocol locked down sleep, food, exercise, literally my entire schedule down to the minute. So, maybe my hypothalamus picked up on that schedule and therefore had [music] a quieter month. The second theory is that it's just coincidence. We don't know yet until we get multiple cycles come back, but this could just be a random calm month. We're going to see what is my next cycle say to see is this actually a trend. The third theory is that this is just cleaner measurement. So, this is the first time where I have the same hydration status, the same time of testing every month, and so maybe
therefore I'm just getting cleaner data back. But the two things that this can't explain is my LH surge and then also this being a shorter month overall.
